title: Volley Wave State
description: Retained full wave snapshot published by a supervisor to volley/_waves/<wave>/state. An archived wave (status archived) is published once and then its retained state is cleared. See spec sections 4.6.1 and 4.6.20.

version.description: Wave file version (bumped on a versioned re-submission).

owner.description: Owning coordinator agent id, or null when the wave is orphaned.

status.description: releasing: every task is settled and the release train (spec section 4.6.19) runs; complete once the owner answers release_go go (or, without a train, once every task is settled).

gates.description: Task ids that are merge-ready and await their merge: the supervisor's merge queue under merge: auto (spec section 4.6.17), a human under merge: manual.

effective_config.description: Global config with this wave's config: overrides applied.

brief_preface.description: The brief preface every agent of the current plan version gets (spec section 4.6.9), or null when the wave has none.

repo_visibility.description: The repository's visibility as the supervisor read it for the current plan version (spec section 4.6.8): unknown when it could not be read, null when the public_hygiene setting (on or off) made reading it unnecessary. Absent: not recorded (a supervisor that predates it).

hygiene_level.description: How the reviewers treat public hygiene for the current plan version (spec section 4.6.8): p1 (every hit blocks the merge; public, or visibility unknown), p3 (non-blocking notes; private or internal) or off. Absent: not recorded, which a supervisor treats as p1.

github.description: The repository on GitHub as the supervisor read it for the current plan version (spec section 4.6.1): slug is owner/repo, url its canonical URL, so a client links issue n as <url>/issues/<n>. Absent when it could not be read; never derived from repo or a remote.

autopilot.description: What the supervisor's autopilot did in this wave (spec section 4.6.16): whether it is on for the wave, the decisions it answered itself and those it left for the owner, and each remediation budget it answered under. Absent: a supervisor that predates autopilot.

archived.description: When, by whom and why the wave was archived (spec section 4.6.20). Only on an archived wave; a supervisor's status listing carries it, the retained topic need not.

merge_queue.description: The merge queue (spec section 4.6.17), in merge order: the wave's gated tasks the supervisor merges itself, one per release branch at a time. merging: its merge is running; updating: it is being brought up to date with the release branch before its merge; queued: waiting for its turn; refused: GitHub refused its last merge, and it goes after the tasks still queued. since: when the task entered the queue. Absent while the queue is empty.

release.description: The release train (spec section 4.6.19), from release_started on: the stage running or awaiting its go (null when none is), and every playbook stage in order with its state. Absent for a wave without a train.

fixerRemediation.description: A flake fixer's remediation (spec section 4.6.16), as its task_queued carries it: the failing test, its file, the runs it failed in and the tasks it blocks.

taskId.description: Task id from the wave file (e.g. T1). Case-preserving; lowercase it when deriving an agent id.

issue.description: The task's GitHub issue; 0 only for a synthetic task (spec section 4.6.16), which has none.

agents.description: Current agent id per pipeline role.

host.description: The remote host the task's agents run on (its name from the wave file, the hosts tunable or placement); absent for the supervisor's own host.

host_down.description: Set while the task's host is a paired machine whose tunnel is down (SPEC §4.6.14): why, e.g. 'no heartbeat for 90 s'. Covers running agents too, not only parked spawns; absent while the machine is up.

placement.description: Where the task was placed and why (spec section 4.6.15); absent until the supervisor places it.

base_sha.description: The release-branch commit the task's current worktree was cut from (spec section 4.6.15).

queued_steers.description: Steering messages the supervisor holds for the task's next agent because none was live when they were sent (SPEC §4.4); absent when none are held.

screen_stale.description: True while the supervisor's screen capture for one of the task's agents is backed off (slow or failing), so its retained screen topic may be out of date.

checks.description: While the supervisor holds the task for CI on head_sha: its runs completed, and all of them.

stage_label.description: While a parallel stage group runs, its label (e.g. 'review (spec + quality)'); stage stays the group's first stage.

stage_group.description: While a parallel stage group runs: each role, its agent and its state.

alarms.description: Alarms on the task that still hold (e.g. merged_unverified_head), each with a human-readable line.

remediation.description: A remediation requested for the task's red head that still holds (spec section 4.6.16): fix_flake, a failing test the PR does not touch awaiting its dedicated fixer. Gone once the head is verified, a new step starts, its fixer's fix landed, or the task is cancelled. On a synthetic task (synthetic: true) it is the fixer's own: test_file, run_urls, for (the tasks it blocks) and, once closed, outcome.

synthetic.description: A task the supervisor added itself, never from the wave file (spec section 4.6.16): a flake's fixer, fix-<slug>, issue 0, with its remediation. Journal-only: absent from spec.

last_error.description: The most recent of the task's unrecovered spawn failures (counted per role): present while any role's spawn has failed and not spawned since; gone once each such role spawns, or the task is cancelled or done.

attempt.description: Spawn attempts in a row that failed (with last_error).

next_retry_at.description: When the supervisor retries the failed spawn on its own; null once it stopped retrying (with last_error).

reviews_skipped_by_plan.description: True once the task reached merge_ready without reviews because its wave-file pipeline lists no review stage (spec section 4.6.8).

host.description: The machine the task runs on; the supervisor's own machine under its fleet.local_name.

by.description: auto: the placement engine chose. wave_file: the wave file named the host. decision: an answered decision (machine_down, a respawn) moved it.

score.description: The chosen host's score; null when the host was not scored (by wave_file).

candidates.description: Every machine considered, best first. The supervisor writes each line; a client shows it and never computes its own.

score.description: null: not eligible, or not scored.

line.description: Why this machine scored as it did, or why it was not eligible, in one human-readable line.

path.description: The preface file, as resolved on the supervisor's host.

pipelineStep.description: A stage name, or a nested array of stage names that run in parallel.

spec.description: The submitted wave file, so a client can render the dependency graph without reading YAML.

coordinator.description: Owner coordinator attention state, maintained by the supervisor from the owner's registry and progress topics. For an owner that is a coordinator name (spec section 6.2), agent_id is the agent bound to it and reconnecting means that agent went away less than autopilot.reconnect_grace_s ago.
